summary.overview: The conversation starts with greetings from both the user and the AI. The AI introduces itself and asks the user to identify their most significant problem, offering options like employment or floods.

conversation.speaker: ai
conversation.text: Namaskar Bhaiya, hum Sunita Devi bolat hain, Rajesh Verma ji ke taraf se. Kaise hain aap? Hum jaanana chahat hain ki aapke yahan kaun si problem sabse badi ba? Rozgar, baadh, ya kuchh aur? Hum sunat hain.
